meaning_en: to direct water flow into agricultural surface channels

past.de: Der Landwirt leitete den Graben zum Obstgarten
past.en: The farmer directed the water flume toward the orchard

present.ar: يَقْنِي المَاءَ العَذْبَ بِحَسَبِ الأَوْقَاتِ المَعْلُومَةِ
present.de: Er kanalisiert das Quellwasser nach festgelegten Zeittakten
present.en: He directs the sweet water according to agreed schedules

imperative.ar: اقْنِ بِالإِنْصَافِ وَأَعْطِ كُلَّ ذِي حَقٍّ نَصِيبَهُ
imperative.de: Leite gerecht und gib jedem seinen vollen Anteil!
imperative.en: Direct with fairness and grant each his rightful share!
